name: cube
notes: main brings up platform, render and world into an App, then mjolnir.run drives update / frame until the window closes.
Builtin meshes (.CUBE, .SPHERE, .QUAD_XZ, .QUAD_XY, .CONE, .CAPSULE, .CYLINDER, .TORUS) and colors are pre-baked by render.init; render.primitive returns an attachment using them.
The update callback runs world.update and feeds removed_nodes / changed_nodes to render; without it nothing moves on screen.

name: animation_layering
desc: Bone-mask layer blending across multiple clips.
notes: The app owns the anim.Animator; add_clip_layer returns the layer index. Pick stable slots for "walk", "run", "upper-body".
BlendMode default .REPLACE (weighted). Use .ADD for additive layers (recoil over aim).
One-shot crossfade between layers: anim.transition_to.
Drive per-layer weight live with anim.set_layer_weight.
Glue in update: animator_update, then render.stage_bones with animator.palette.

name: aoe
notes: physics.overlap with a SphereCollider lists the bodies inside the effect radius.
Mouse picking: render.cursor_ray → physics.raycast; hit.body keys the body → mesh map.
For continuous overlap events, create a body with is_sensor = true and read phys.sensor_overlaps after step.

name: bullet_wall_ccd
desc: Fast projectiles don't tunnel through thin walls.
notes: No extra setup — the step keeps fast bodies from tunneling automatically.
Tune response through body := physics.get_body(&phys, h): body.friction, body.restitution, body.linear_damping, body.angular_damping.
Set phys.gravity = {0,0,0} on your physics.World for pure ballistic tests.

name: cameras
notes: The app holds a render.CameraController and calls render.camera_controller_update each tick. Switch by assigning it (orbit_controller, free_controller, follow_controller), or {} to disable it.
Controllers read the tick's input.State through their bindings (CameraBindings) and skip devices a UI captured.
Orbit reads distance, yaw and pitch from the camera pose each tick, so warping the camera never snaps it back.
Follow controller tracks FollowCameraData.target; update it each tick.

name: collision
desc: Static and dynamic bodies of every shape, moved and reshaped live.
notes: physics.set_pose / set_collider move or reshape a body and keep the BVH consistent; moving a static body makes it kinematic.
physics.raycast tests rotated boxes and cylinders exactly and returns the surface normal.

name: crowd_nav
desc: Detour crowd agents navigating a navmesh.
notes: Bake once: bake.append_triangles for ground and obstacles, then bake.build.
crowd.create on &navmesh; agents via crowd.add_agent (start from crowd.DEFAULT_AGENT_PARAMS), goals via crowd.move_to.
crowd.update each tick handles path following, obstacle avoidance and separation; read crowd.get_agent(c, id).npos.
Heavy bakes — do them at setup or after major scene changes only.

name: debug_draw
desc: Line-strip primitives and debug bone overlay.
notes: render.debug_segment, debug_aabb, debug_sphere, debug_arrow, debug_axes queue lines; life keeps them for that many seconds of render's clock, zero for one frame.
Skeletons: feed anim.bone_segments(&animator, &skel, root_world) to render.debug_segment.

name: forcefield
desc: Vortex force field dragging particles around it.
notes: strength negative = repel, positive = attract. tangent_strength swirls.
Parent + child trick orbits the field around a point cheaply (rotate the parent).
Cap is MAX_FORCE_FIELDS = 32.

name: gltf_animation
notes: mjolnir.load_gltf returns a GltfScene: one anim.Rig per skin and a skinned list of {node, rig}.
Create one anim.Animator per skinned entry; anim.play(&a, rig, name) puts a clip on layer 0.
Animation names match animations[i].name. Empty names become Anim_0, Anim_1, …

name: gltf_static
notes: mjolnir.load_gltf returns root nodes; children wire into the scene graph automatically.
Embedded textures upload via render.create_texture_from_data; PBR maps (metallic, roughness, emissive) are picked up.
Each glTF mesh becomes one render mesh, shared by every node that uses it.
load_gltf blocks — wrap with core:thread for background loads.

name: grid
notes: One mesh + one material handle shared across 90k nodes — each draw is a u32 lookup on the GPU.
Big destroy/create swaps need a FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT gap so the staging pipeline can drain.

name: ik
notes: anim.add_ik_chain_layer walks the skeleton from root to tip. add_ik_layer takes the bone list directly.
weight = 0 disables IK without removing the layer.
anim.ik_constraints_uniform sets swing and twist limits per joint.
.WORLD space targets use the root_world passed to animator_update.

name: input_demo
notes: Read the app's input.State (filled by platform.read_input) in update: input.key_down / key_pressed / key_released, mouse_*, cursor, mouse_delta, scroll, text, axis.
The snapshot is stable for the whole tick; a tap between two ticks still reports both edges.
Skip reactions while input.mouse_captured / input.keyboard_captured is set — a UI owns that device.

name: jump
desc: Character controller, movement are powered by physics engine.
notes: The cube is a dynamic body; physics.apply_force moves it from input.axis, apply_impulse jumps on input.key_pressed(.SPACE).
physics.set_mass sets the mass and recomputes the inertia from the collider.
Glue in update: physics.step, then copy physics.body_poses into the world.

name: level_management
desc: Destroying resources and reloading a level.
notes: Reload with mjolnir.teardown then mjolnir.setup at the top of update (a reset_requested flag set by the UI); app-owned state (animators, glTF scenes) is reset in the setup callback.
App-created meshes and materials are freed explicitly with render.destroy_mesh / destroy_material; builtins survive every teardown.

name: lights
notes: Color vector's w channel doubles as intensity.
cast_shadow = true allocates a 2D shadow map (SHADOW_MAP_SIZE = 512).
Point-light cubemap shadows need -define:REQUIRE_GEOMETRY_SHADER=true.
Change a light live through render.attachment(&r, node.index, render.PointLightAttachment) (color, radius, disabled, …), then write it back with render.attach.

name: material
notes: metallic / roughness drive the BRDF; scalar factors stack with optional textures.
base_color_factor tints the albedo map (multiplicative).

name: navmesh
notes: Accumulate triangles with bake.append_triangles into a NavGeometryBuilder, then bake.build.
nav.debug_triangles gives the built polygons for drawing.
Mouse-pick onto the navmesh: cursor ray → nav.raycast → nav.find_path.
Heavy build — do it at setup or after big scene changes.

name: obj_loader
notes: mesh.load_obj (render/mesh) returns positions + indices; mesh.from_triangles turns them into a render mesh. .mtl is ignored.
from_triangles computes smooth vertex normals.

name: orthographic_camera
notes: render.main_camera_set_orthographic takes ortho width/height instead of FOV.
Good for 2.5D, minimaps, isometric views, or shadow casters.

name: particles
notes: Emitter follows its node — translate the node, the source moves.
weight is gravity-like; negative floats particles up.
Simulated on the GPU in a ring of MAX_PARTICLES = 65536; the oldest particles are overwritten when it is full.
position_spread + velocity_spread randomize the burst cone.

name: path_modifier
desc: Procedural bone modifier following a spline.
notes: Path is a [][3]f32 — internally promoted to a Catmull-Rom spline.
Tune offset + speed with anim.set_path_params to scrub along the path.
loop = true repeats; otherwise the chain pins to the end.

name: pbr
notes: Ambient pass samples the loaded environment map + BRDF LUT.
Tune app.renderer.ambient.ibl_intensity and render.add_effect to balance IBL vs. direct light.

name: physics
notes: Each body is a physics.create_body call with user set to its node; mass = 0 makes it static, a dynamic body gets its inertia from its collider.
Glue in update: physics.step, then world.set_world_pose for every physics.body_poses entry.
physics.World.gravity defaults to {0, -9.81, 0}.

name: post_process
desc: Bloom, DoF, fog, tonemap, outline, crosshatch.
notes: Effects run in insertion order. Conventional chain: fog → bloom → tonemap.
clear(&app.renderer.post_process.effect_stack) + rebuild on settings change. No need to rebuild every frame.
Helper procs: add_outline, add_fog, add_dof, add_bloom, add_blur, add_crosshatch, add_grayscale, add_tonemap.

name: procedural_mesh
notes: Build a mesh.Geometry (render/mesh) at runtime, hand it to render.create_mesh.
Tangents are auto-filled if missing.
create_mesh(..., auto_purge = true) drops the CPU copy once every frame in flight has the upload.

name: render_to_texture
desc: Secondary camera rendered into a bindless texture.
notes: Skip POST_PROCESS / UI on non-main cameras to save GPU time.
render.camera_attachment returns a Texture2DHandle — sample it from any material or UI quad.
Re-bind in post_render each frame so per-frame ping-pong picks the right attachment.

name: scene_graph
notes: spawn_child parents at creation; world.attach / detach rewire later.
Local transforms multiply through the chain — rotate a parent, all children orbit.
despawn removes the whole subtree.

name: spider_leg_modifier
desc: Procedural spider legs — IK + parabolic foot lift.
notes: One layer drives all legs; per-leg time_offset staggers the gait (tripod by default).
lift_height + lift_frequency + lift_duration shape the foot arc.
Read or move a foot target via anim.spider_leg_target.

name: spline
notes: Catmull-Rom by default. spline_sample(s, t) with t in [0,1].
Build an arc-length table for uniform-speed traversal along the curve.

name: sprite
notes: frame_columns × frame_rows defines the sprite-sheet layout.
render.set_sprite_frame shows one cell; the example picks it from elapsed time for loop, ping-pong and once playback.
Sprites billboard toward the active camera.

name: tail_modifier
notes: propagation_speed low ⇒ stiff tail; high ⇒ whippy.
damping controls how fast bones return to rest.
Tune live with anim.set_tail_params — Maybe fields mean only values you pass get updated.

name: transparent
notes: Materials with type = .TRANSPARENT draw in the forward pass after lighting, alpha-blended into the HDR target without writing depth.

name: ui
desc: 2D UI widgets, layout, events, fontstash text.
notes: Coordinates are pixels, origin top-left.
Per-widget z_order; higher draws on top.
The engine runs ui.process_input each tick. Widgets with handlers receive HOVER_IN / HOVER_OUT / MOVE / CLICK_DOWN / CLICK_UP; a click gives focus, and the focused widget gets key and text events.
Set event_handlers and user_data on the widget (or via ui.get_widget_base); handlers read event.user_data.

name: wireframe
notes: render.material_wireframe makes a material drawn by the wireframe forward pipeline.
Useful for debug overlays; bypasses the G-buffer.

name: snake
notes: Full game: input → grid sim → spawn/despawn nodes → score UI.
Game state lives in the App struct instead of file globals.

name: torus_tetris
notes: The board wraps around — pieces falling off one edge re-enter the opposite side.
Mixes UI text, dynamic spawn, and procedural mesh for the playfield.
